title: Cake for 20 guests near Merrylands? Eggless 10-inch from $74.99
summary:
A 10-inch eggless cake serves 20 to 22 people. Starting at $74.99, made to order and ready for pickup at Harris Park.

Most Merrylands and Granville families we hear from have the same problem: the guest list says 20, the cake says 12. Size is the part people get wrong, which is why we ask the headcount first and the design second.

6-inch serves 6-8 from $39.99. 8-inch serves 12-14 from $49.99. 10-inch serves 20-22. Every one is 100% eggless, in 15 flavours, so nobody at the table needs to check.

Order with 48 hours notice. Pickup from Shop 1, 96-98 Wigram Street, daily 11am to 10pm.
